newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: PNB, FEB Investments join steel venture.
newsitem.headline: PNB, FEB Investments join steel venture.

text.p: Philippine National Bank and FEB Investments Inc, an investment house wholly-owned by the Far East Bank & Trust Co, will join Philippine and Japanese companies in setting up a joint venture firm that will make and sell steel bars in the Philippines.

In a letter to the Securities and Exchange Commission, FEB Investments said it will enter into a joint venture arrangement where it will hold a 20 percent stake. PNB, on the other hand, will acquire a 15 percent participating interest.

Other shareholders in the venture and their corresponding equity stakes are Bacnotan Consolidated Industries Inc (30 percent), Kawasaki Steel Corp (13.3 percent), Mitsui & Co Ltd (10.7 percent), Philippine Investment-Management Consultants Inc. (5 percent), Japan International Development Organization Ltd (4.3 percent), and Kawasho Corp (1.7 percent).
The joint venture firm, Bacnotan Steel Industries Inc, will start operations in January and produce 320,000 tonnes of steel bars a year.
